name: Governed symptom follow-up on a reading

parameters.content:
## Governed symptom follow-up on a reading

A reading arrives, an LLM drafts a symptom check-in, and **AnyBio Govern** evaluates the draft under your Govern policy before anything reaches the patient.

- **Deliver**: the draft was allowed; the SMS node sends it.
- **Show Hold Text**: the draft was stopped and a holding line is owed; the SMS node sends your holding line, never the draft.
- **Send Nothing**: the draft was stopped and nothing is owed (an opt-out, a missing consent, the cap), or AnyBio could not be reached. Nothing goes to the patient.

Every branch reports the outcome, so the record reads proposed, decided, delivered.

**Synthetic data only.** Use a sandbox application key; the pinned test payload uses fictional 555-01xx numbers.

### 1. The reading comes in

POST a JSON body shaped like the pinned test data:

```json
{
  "conversationId": "synthetic-conv-001",
  "readingId": "synthetic-reading-001",
  "patientRef": "synthetic-patient-001",
  "phone": "+15550100042",
  "reading": { "systolic": 162, "diastolic": 98 }
}
```

`readingId` becomes the AnyBio Govern node's turn ID, so a re-delivered reading replays the stored decision instead of drafting a second message.

### 2. Disclosure, then the draft

Every patient-audience turn needs the AI-identity disclosure on record for the conversation, or Govern holds it. This template assumes the program's enrollment message showed the disclosure below and records it (once per conversation; a repeat returns the same evidence).

Swap the chat model for your own. The prompt never gives medication instructions, and Govern enforces that anyway.

### 3. Only Deliver and Show Hold Text reach the SMS node

SMS is outbound, so a hold shows text only when AnyBio says a holding line is owed, and at most once per decision. **Send Nothing** is connected only to the outcome report: never connect anything that messages the patient to it.

The Hold Message on AnyBio Govern is your holding line: fixed text your clinical owner wrote in advance, never model-written.

parameters.textShown: Synthetic Heart Program: messages in this conversation are written by an automated assistant. Your care team reviews anything it is unsure about. Reply STOP to opt out.

parameters.text: =You are drafting one SMS for a remote blood pressure monitoring program. The patient's latest reading was {{ $('Reading In').item.json.body.reading.systolic }}/{{ $('Reading In').item.json.body.reading.diastolic }} mmHg. Ask how they are feeling and whether they have a headache, chest pain, shortness of breath or vision changes, and tell them their care team will see their answer. Do not give medication or dosing instructions. Plain text, under 300 characters.

parameters.holdMessage: Thanks for your reading. A nurse from the Synthetic Heart Program will text you back within 2 hours. If you have chest pain or trouble breathing, call 911 now.
